name: rooftop-ninja
title: First Light
premise: Side story, seen mostly through the shadow ninja's own eyes (pov). He never speaks: only his thoughts and captions in his own voice. He is a recent arrival who loves films and is quietly working out what life is about, so he thinks about what he is doing the way a film lover would: shots, takes, lenses, light. Tonight he crosses the rooftop, crouch, look around, sneak along the ledge, sprint, vault the wall, land, to reach the one spot with the perfect view before the sun comes up; the sword comes out only at the very end and only as something to catch the first light on (his pinhole camera stayed at home). Follow the hero clip in order from start to finish on the rooftop, and set the last one or two panels in rooftop-dawn. Use pov for most panels, with two or three outside views (wide or close-up) so we see who it is. Gentle, warm, a little funny, Sanrio-kind; the last panel is quiet, not a punchline.
